segments.text: It begins with understanding the OSHA hazard communication standard, because without communication,
segments.zh: 一切都从理解 OSHA 危害沟通标准开始，因为没有沟通，

segments.text: you aren't able to foster awareness.
segments.zh: 你就无法培养意识。

segments.text: Everyone who might come in contact with the materials in question have to be aware of
segments.zh: 每一个可能接触到相关材料的人，都必须了解

segments.text: their danger, their proper handling, and what to do when there is an emergency.
segments.zh: 它们的危险、正确的处理方法，以及发生紧急情况时该怎么做。

segments.text: OSHA sets out some rules for communication standards, including that chemical manufacturers
segments.zh: OSHA 为沟通标准制定了一些规则，包括化学品制造商

segments.text: and importers are required to evaluate the hazards of the chemicals that they produce
segments.zh: 和进口商必须评估他们生产

segments.text: or import.
segments.zh: 或进口的化学品的危害。

segments.text: This includes preparing labels and safety data sheets that convey hazard information to downstream
segments.zh: 这包括编制标签和安全技术说明书，向下游客户传达危害

segments.text: customers.
segments.zh: 信息。

segments.text: Also, all employers with hazardous chemicals in their workplaces need labels and safety
segments.zh: 此外，所有工作场所存在危险化学品的雇主，都需要为接触这些化学品的工人提供标签和安全

segments.text: data sheets for their exposed workers, and they need to offer adequate training so they
segments.zh: 技术说明书，并且需要提供充分的培训，让他们

segments.text: can handle these materials appropriately.
segments.zh: 能够恰当地处理这些材料。

segments.text: Employee training also has to include information on the hazards of their work area and any
segments.zh: 员工培训还必须包括有关其工作区域的危害信息，以及

segments.text: measures they must take to protect themselves.
segments.zh: 他们为保护自己必须采取的任何措施。

segments.text: As with any communication, there are some basic terms to know.
segments.zh: 和任何沟通一样，有一些基本术语需要了解。

segments.text: Let's look at some essential terms as outlined by OSHA.
segments.zh: 我们来看看 OSHA 列出的一些基本术语。

segments.text: First is the action level.
segments.zh: 首先是行动水平。

segments.text: This is set at an airborne level, typically one half of the PEL, or permissible exposure
segments.zh: 这是设定的一个空气中浓度水平，通常是 PEL，也就是允许暴露

segments.text: limit, that's designated in OSHA's substance-specific standard.
segments.zh: 限值的一半，PEL 在 OSHA 针对具体物质的标准中有规定。

segments.text: That's 29 CFR 1910 subpart Z.
segments.zh: 也就是 29 CFR 1910 Z 分部。

segments.text: It's calculated as an eight-hour time-weighted average, which starts off certain required
segments.zh: 它按八小时时间加权平均值计算，达到它就要启动某些必需的

segments.text: activities like exposure monitoring and medical surveillance.
segments.zh: 活动，比如暴露监测和医学监护。

segments.text: Then there's the ceiling limit.
segments.zh: 然后是上限值。

segments.text: That's the exposure limit a worker's exposure may never exceed.
segments.zh: 这是工人的暴露在任何时候都不得超过的暴露限值。

segments.text: Then you have sampling and analytical error.
segments.zh: 然后是采样与分析误差。

segments.text: This is a statistical estimate of the uncertainty that's associated when you're given exposure
segments.zh: 这是对给定暴露测量值所关联的不确定度的

segments.text: measurement.
segments.zh: 统计估计。

segments.text: Then you have STEL, which is the short-term exposure limit.
segments.zh: 然后是 STEL，也就是短时间暴露限值。

segments.text: That's the average exposure to a contaminant to which a worker might be exposed during
segments.zh: 这是工人在一段短时间内可能接触到的某种污染物的

segments.text: a short period of time, typically 15 to 30 minutes.
segments.zh: 平均暴露量，这段时间通常为 15 到 30 分钟。

segments.text: And finally, you have the TWA, which is the time-weighted average.
segments.zh: 最后是 TWA，也就是时间加权平均值。

segments.text: That's the average exposure to a contaminant over a given period of time, typically eight
segments.zh: 这是在给定时间段内对某种污染物的平均暴露量，这段时间通常为八

segments.text: hours.
segments.zh: 小时。

segments.text: Generally, we use two major terms across industries, combustible and flammable liquids.
segments.zh: 一般来说，各行业通用两个主要术语：可燃液体和易燃液体。

segments.text: OSHA outlines standards for what these are, but you've got to keep in mind the safety
segments.zh: OSHA 规定了这两者的标准，但你必须记住，安全

segments.text: standards might be different for construction zones.
segments.zh: 标准在施工区域可能会有所不同。

segments.text: Looking at combustible liquids, this is defined as any liquid having a flash point at or
segments.zh: 先看可燃液体，它的定义是任何闪点等于或

segments.text: above 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
segments.zh: 高于 100 华氏度的液体。

segments.text: For flammable liquids, it's defined as any liquid having a flash point below 100 degrees
segments.zh: 易燃液体的定义是任何闪点低于 100 华氏度的液体，

segments.text: Fahrenheit, excepting any mixture that has components with flash points of 100 degrees
segments.zh: 但不包括这样的混合物：它含有闪点为 100 华氏度

segments.text: Fahrenheit, or higher, the total of which make up 99% or more of the total volume of
segments.zh: 或更高的组分，这些组分合计占总体积的 99% 或更多，

segments.text: the mixture.
segments.zh: 是该混合物的主体。

segments.text: Generally speaking, you might notice that flammable is used as a catch-all term which
segments.zh: 一般来说，你可能会注意到，“易燃”被用作一个笼统的术语，

segments.text: comprises a wide range of risks.
segments.zh: 涵盖了范围很广的各种风险。
